Attica chips and onion dip.d: Ridged and salty, with onions cooked slow till deep brown in sour cream, cream cheese and chives.
Attica chips and onion dip.note: One big bowl for the counter.

Deli hero wedges.d: Ham, salami, provolone, iceberg and tomato on long rolls, oil, red wine vinegar, oregano. Pressed.

Hostage pizza.d: Thin crust, crushed tomato and oregano, low-moisture mozzarella, baked fast in a very hot oven.
Hostage pizza.note: Two pies. Pay the kid at the door.

Italian ice.d: Fresh juice and zest, sugar and water, frozen and scraped fluffy.
Italian ice.note: A cup each. Not for Mr. Mulvaney.

Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt.d: Lager over ice and a squeeze of fresh juice, chili salt on the rim.
Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt.note: By the bottle. For after closing.
